objective: Diagnosticar el bloque pendiente de CIENFUEGOS alrededor del 2026-02-04. Comparar Runtime V2, detalle canónico guardado y SoftRestaurant actual usando turnos.apertura para 2026-02-03 a 2026-02-05. Determinar si la diferencia viene de encabezado histórico, detalle o POS. Solo lectura; no modificar datos ni Producción.

queries.name: cienfuegos_runtime_20260203_05
queries.sql:
SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion,
                      CAST(ventas_total AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_runtime,
                      tickets_total AS tickets_runtime,
                      pax_total AS pax_runtime,
                      sync_run_id
               FROM dbo.Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2
               WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS'
                 AND fecha_operacion>='2026-02-03'
                 AND fecha_operacion<'2026-02-06'
               ORDER BY fecha_operacion

queries.name: cienfuegos_detail_20260203_05
queries.sql:
WITH t AS (
                 SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha_operacion,
                        numero_ticket,
                        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(18,4))) venta_ticket,
                        MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax_ticket
                 FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
                 WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS'
                   AND fecha_operacion>='2026-02-03'
                   AND fecha_operacion<'2026-02-06'
                   AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1
                   AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1
                 GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date),numero_ticket
               )
               SELECT fecha_operacion,
                      CAST(SUM(venta_ticket) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_detalle,
                      COUNT(*) AS tickets_detalle,
                      SUM(pax_ticket) AS pax_detalle
               FROM t
               GROUP BY fecha_operacion
               ORDER BY fecha_operacion

queries.name: cienfuegos_pos_by_apertura_20260203_05
queries.sql:
SELECT CONVERT(date,tr.apertura) AS fecha_apertura,
                      CAST(SUM(ISNULL(ch.total,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_pos,
                      COUNT(DISTINCT ch.folio) AS tickets_pos,
                      SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_pos,
                      MIN(tr.apertura) AS apertura_min,
                      MAX(tr.apertura) AS apertura_max
               FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
               WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-02-03'
                 AND tr.apertura<'2026-02-06'
                 AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
               GROUP BY CONVERT(date,tr.apertura)
               ORDER BY fecha_apertura

queries.name: cienfuegos_turnos_20260203_05
queries.sql:
SELECT tr.idturno,tr.apertura,tr.cierre,
                      CAST(SUM(ISNULL(ch.total,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS venta,
                      COUNT(DISTINCT ch.folio) AS tickets,
                      SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS bigint)) AS pax,
                      MIN(ch.fecha) AS cheque_fecha_min,
                      MAX(ch.fecha) AS cheque_fecha_max,
                      MIN(ch.cierre) AS cheque_cierre_min,
                      MAX(ch.cierre) AS cheque_cierre_max
               FROM turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK) ON ch.idturno=tr.idturno
               WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-02-03'
                 AND tr.apertura<'2026-02-06'
                 AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
               GROUP BY tr.idturno,tr.apertura,tr.cierre
               ORDER BY tr.apertura

queries.name: cienfuegos_zero_total_20260203_05
queries.sql:
SELECT CONVERT(date,tr.apertura) AS fecha_apertura,
                      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ISNULL(ch.total,0)=0 THEN ch.folio END) AS tickets_total_cero,
                      SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(ch.total,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) ELSE 0 END) AS pax_total_cero
               FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
               WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-02-03'
                 AND tr.apertura<'2026-02-06'
                 AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
               GROUP BY CONVERT(date,tr.apertura)
               ORDER BY fecha_apertura
